gloss: in rapid succession; one after another

definitions.gloss: in rapid succession; one after another; in a row
definitions.explanation: Describes events or actions occurring one right after the other without pause.

examples.japanese: {続|つづ}けざま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was asked questions in rapid succession.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{続|つづ}けざま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{続|つづ}けざま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三杯|さんばい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: He drank three beers in a row.

notes:
Almost always used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as {続|つづ}けざま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Emphasizes the lack of interval between events. Derived from ⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue) + さま (manner).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {続|つづ}けざま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧: to happen in succession
- {続|つづ}けざま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to strike repeatedly
- {続|つづ}けざま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink one after another

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立|た}て{続|つづ}け→立て続け：13765_tatetsuzuke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in succession — very close synonym, equally common
- ⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: one after another — broader, can have longer gaps between events
- {矢継|やつ}ぎ{早|ばや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in rapid-fire succession — emphasizes speed
